PlayerCloudProfile.title: PlayerCloudProfile
PlayerCloudProfile.description: Stores a player's tactical profile card, active goal check-in, challenge commitment, and development progress.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated player/parent account.

positionAndGrade.description: The player's court position and grade level.

activeGoal.description: The player's current tactical goal selected during welcome check-in.

challengeAccepted.description: Whether the player accepted today's Coach Keith tactical challenge.

courtStrengths.description: Summary of the player's tactical court strengths.

completedScopesCount.description: Count of completed scopes of work.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

PracticeScopeOfWork.title: PracticeScopeOfWork
PracticeScopeOfWork.description: Represents a comprehensive tactical practice plan and scope of work assigned by Coach Keith.

userId.description: The UID of the player household this scope of work belongs to.

assignmentId.description: Identifier linking to the drill assignment.

title.description: Title of the tactical practice plan.

tacticalObjective.description: Core game-situation objective for this scope of work.

scopeBreakdown.description: Detailed rep-by-rep and phase breakdown of the scope of work.

requiredFilmAngle.description: Recommended camera angle for uploading player practice film.

successStandard.description: Coach Keith's measurable standard for completing the scope.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the scope of work.

VideoCritiqueSubmission.title: VideoCritiqueSubmission
VideoCritiqueSubmission.description: Represents a player's uploaded practice video metadata, reflection, and Coach Keith's tactical film critique.

userId.description: The UID of the player who submitted the video clip.

assignmentId.description: The assignment ID associated with this video submission.

videoLabel.description: Display name or clip summary of the selected video.

cameraAngle.description: Court camera angle tag (e.g., Wing / Corner Read).

playerObservation.description: What the player noticed and decided during the film rep.

coachCritique.description: Coach Keith's tactical critique of the player's video.

filmTimestampNotes.description: Timestamped breakdown notes from Coach Keith (e.g., [0:04] Footwork, [0:09] Help read).

nextRepAdjustment.description: Coach Keith's specific adjustment for the next rep.

status.description: Review status of the video submission.

CoachPlayerMessage.title: CoachPlayerMessage
CoachPlayerMessage.description: Represents a message in the two-way tactical communication thread between the player/parent and Coach Keith.

userId.description: The UID of the player household thread owner.

assignmentId.description: The assignment ID or 'general' topic this message is attached to.

followUpPrompt.description: Contextual next-step prompt suggested after this message.

/users/{userId}/player_profiles/{profile.description: Stores the player's tactical profile card, goal check-in, and challenge state.

/users/{userId}/practice_scopes/{scopeId.description: Stores tactical practice plans and scopes of work for the player.

/users/{userId}/video_submissions/{submi.description: Stores player practice video uploads and Coach Keith's tactical film critiques.

/users/{userId}/coach_messages/{messageI.description: Stores two-way tactical messages between the player/parent and Coach Keith.
